drivers: Blank cells representing 'zero figures' obscure the count progression and shape distribution, requiring an inference that blank = 0
Three attributes (shape, fill, count) must each be resolved; rotation is non-discriminating across options so it can be ignored
Shape-fill coupling is consistent (triangles always empty), and row-wise distribution of three makes shape and fill deducible by elimination
Distractors D and G capture plausible single-attribute errors (count from column reading, fill ignored); 8 options and 105 s give moderate pressure
